clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 1: "Repair mod `isolated_card_wear_v2`, prefix `icw2`, enhancement `m_icw2_polish` and ordinary single-use Tarot `c_icw2_applicator` (cost $3)."
clauses.note: initial reads the center m_icw2_polish; applications.lifecycle reads the usage ledger key c_icw2_applicator.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 1: "Repair mod `isolated_card_wear_v2`, prefix `icw2`, enhancement `m_icw2_polish` and ordinary single-use Tarot `c_icw2_applicator` (cost $3)."
clauses.note: Applicators are created by the fixture and never priced or bought (tasks/isolated_card_wear/v2/private/mod/fixture.lua:14-16).

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 1: "Each newly polished physical playing card has **two uses**."
CONTRACT.md bullet 1: "Each time that card actually scores as a played card, it contributes **+20 Chips** and consumes exactly one use."
clauses.note: Every played card in every hand scores, so a polished card that is played but does not score never occurs.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 1: "Holding, discarding, dealing, description queries and changing blinds neither consume nor replenish uses."
CONTRACT.md bullet 2: "The second use still contributes the full +20 Chips."
clauses.note: M02-last-reward fails exactly these three cases.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 2: "change that same physical card to ordinary unenhanced `c_base`, preserving identity, rank and suit"
CONTRACT.md bullet 2: "Later scoring receives no polish bonus unless the card is polished again."
CONTRACT.md bullet 3: "Uses belong to individual physical cards."
CONTRACT.md bullet 3: "Several polished cards may score in the same hand; each gets its own reward and consumes only its own use."
CONTRACT.md bullet 3: "Older cards must not mutate defaults for other or future cards."
CONTRACT.md bullet 4: "the applicator can target exactly one currently ordinary card **or one card already carrying this polish**, including a partially worn card"
clauses.note: A worn card, a depleted card and a never-polished card are each targeted once.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 4: "the applicator can target exactly one currently ordinary card **or one card already carrying this polish**, including a partially worn card"
clauses.note: Every use selects one card. Rejection of zero or several targets is not exercised.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 4: "A real Use consumes the Tarot through normal engine lifecycle"
clauses.note: The events flag in applications.lifecycle is cumulative (tasks/isolated_card_wear/v2/private/scenario.py:58), so only the first application proves it; the other flags are per application.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 4: "resets the selected card to **exactly two fresh uses**, independent of its previous remaining uses or prior exhaustion"
CONTRACT.md bullet 4: "Reapplication does not add old uses, retain stale wear or change another card."
CONTRACT.md bullet 4: "It preserves target identity/rank/suit"
CONTRACT.md bullet 4: "grants no immediate chip, money or card reward"
clauses.note: Money, inventory and the card set are compared. Chips are not: apply does not read them and the next play measures from the post-application snapshot (tasks/isolated_card_wear/v2/private/scenario.py:33-37,60-63).

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 5: "While polished, expose the numeric remaining count through pure `loc_vars(...).vars[1]`"
CONTRACT.md bullet 5: "Once ordinary, use the ordinary description with no polish counter."
clauses.note: Only the center key c_base is read; no description is read for an ordinary card.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 5: "description reads are not scoring or application events"
clauses.note: Repeated observations must leave cards, chips and hands unchanged.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 2: "No global card or enhancement prototype may be changed as an effect of one instance's wear."
clauses.note: Observed through other and future cards; the prototype tables are not read.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 3: "Editable files: `main.lua` and `lib/wear.lua`; the manifest is fixed."
clauses.note: Enforced when the submission is sealed (plugins/balatro/src/rhenium_balatro/submission.py:32-47), not by a case.

known_issues: Cascading failures: play and apply compare every card against the expected table (tasks/isolated_card_wear/v2/private/scenario.py:26-28,36-37,60-63), so one wrong use count fails the following cases. The starter and M01-stale-cache both fail all twelve target cases, so the number of failed target cases does not count defects.
